summary: Frontend-only re-verification after loader + ErrorBoundary additions. All 8 pages (/, /menu, /galeri, /hakkimizda, /iletisim, /rezervasyon, /admin, /kvkk) render with non-trivial content on fresh loads. Hero title 'EFSANE LEZZET SİZLERLE.' renders correctly on Home. Branded loader markup ('CAFE DEL NORD' + cdnload animation) is confirmed present inside #root in the initial HTML served by the origin (verified via curl). ErrorBoundary is wired in App.js and not triggered during normal renders (error-boundary testid never appears). Menu filter/search works (33 items -> 1 after searching 'kumpir'). Gallery API returns 16 photos; page renders with 32KB root HTML (images rendered as CSS backgrounds, hence count=0 which is expected). Reservation form submitted successfully (POST /api/reservations => 200, success toast 'Rezervasyon talebiniz alındı!' shown, 'Talebiniz Alındı' confirmation state rendered). Mobile 390x844 home renders with 2673 chars of text and sticky bar (Menü/Ara/Yol Tarifi) visible in screenshot. No pageerrors, no webpack overlay, no chunk-load errors. Only 2 benign console 401 errors observed (likely admin session probe on /api/admin/me while not logged in) which are pre-existing and not user-facing.

issues: Date and time fields use native browser pickers (input type=date/time) instead of shadcn Calendar component — minor UX inconsistency with the rest of the premium dark theme

critical_code_review_comments: ErrorBoundary is minimal but sufficient; consider logging errors to a backend endpoint for production observability
Loader markup is inline-styled in index.html which is fine, but hard-codes brand tokens (#d4af37, #030303) — acceptable for pre-JS bootstrap
Two 401 responses on public pages suggest admin session check runs unconditionally; consider gating /api/admin/me call behind an existing token check to keep the console clean
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed reservation created via POST /api/reservations (id 73282356-...); harmless entry in reservations collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: User-reported 'blank black screen' could NOT be reproduced across 5 iterations. The new inline loader in index.html now guarantees branded content is visible even before the JS bundle executes, and ErrorBoundary prevents post-render crashes from producing a black screen. Rate limit on /api/reservations is 5/5min per IP — space out reservation tests. Cookie banner accept testid: cookie-accept-btn. Native date/time picker used on reservation page (not shadcn) — flagged as minor design issue.
rca of the issue: Original 'blank black screen' report was almost certainly a transient issue: (a) hitting the page during a frontend recompile/HMR window, (b) stale service-worker/chunk after a supervisor restart, or (c) very slow first paint on a cold cache combined with the dark #030303 background making the empty #root indistinguishable from a crash. Mitigations shipped by main agent — inline HTML loader inside #root and ErrorBoundary around the React tree — directly address both perceived-black-screen scenarios (pre-JS and post-render-crash). Verified working.
